## Checklist

- [ ] The tests in AGENTS.md pass, under a scratch `HOME`.
- [ ] `claude plugin validate .` passes if I touched a skill or the agent.
- [ ] `python3 .github/check-skills.py code-audit harness-audit notion-task-pages plain-prose` passes.
- [ ] I raised `version` in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` if I changed a skill or the agent.
- [ ] A new tool has its README row, `install.sh` entry, AGENTS.md line and CI line.
- [ ] I have read the code of conduct (CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, real names or private data in fixtures, logs or screenshots.
